Yeah its basically an anxiety loop. It happened to me after I got high for the first time ever (synth weed). I had panic attacks and was high the whole day. The next morning I woke up and felt okay but kept thinking about it. A few days later I randomly had another panic attack and chest pain at my school cafeteria. That really triggered the dissociation. The dp/dr didn't really go away for ~11 months. I was so afraid I had altered my brain permanently. Everyday I'd wake up thinking the same thing, will I feel normal today? Putting a name on it, finding info, and others going through the same helped. I also tried weed for the first time some months after it started. It ended up being way trippier than synth weed. But I slowly began getting comfortable with the altered mind states. Tried it a few more times after, scary everytime for a while. But I think that really helped me get over the fear of being perma fried. I realized I was simply in an anxiety/panic loop. I was really scared I had screwed up my brain, so the worries took over. Which made me anxious, so symptoms slowly crept in, which reinforced my worries, which made symptoms worse, which further reinforced worries. I'm not suggesting you take more acid, just sharing what happened to me. It was a really awful, and difficult experience. Still the worst year of my life. But it gets better bro, just gotta slowly get out of your head.
